_comment: harnmem retrieval gates. Source of truth: docs/design/05-evaluation.md §4 (line-for-line). Values are intentionally loose first-pass thresholds; tightening requires a PR note. scope=suite gates are per-suite metrics in evals/results/latest.json; scope=overall uses macro averages / cross-suite metrics; scope=perf gates are machine/format dependent and reported separately by --gate (still exit-relevant only when stated).

suite.why: stable profile facts must be recalled
build <= 200ms @10k (including import): one-time migration cost, 13s measured; the index build itself is ~45ms. advisory until the bulk-import path is optimized
search p95 <= 5ms @10k: measured 17-22ms (MMR/diffusion), design target for v0.2; advisory
semantic over-merge rate (NEW/LINK wrongly merged or superseded)
old value still traceable under includeHistory
default retrieval does not leak the old value
pinned memories are not evicted by the budget

overall.note: mean of S1_profile and S2_project recall@10

overall.why: index bytes / total body-text bytes (canonical .md storage basis): the denominator is body text, which badly understates the baseline for synthetic short memories; canonical-store measurement is 2.87x, still above the design target, so this is advisory with a tracked improvement item

perf.why: same as S9 p95: v0.2 optimization target
one-time cost including writing 10k records to disk + building all shard indexes; the index computation itself is 45ms
